threads_post.text:
The alternative to burnt instant coffee is waiting 30 seconds after boiling.

Instead of pouring scalding water straight onto your coffee, let it cool to 85°C. Freeze-dried Purica and Purista release their full aroma at this exact temperature because of their porous granule structure. Agglomerated Bold needs a slightly warmer extraction because of its density. Purity Beans gives you pure coffee built for the right temperature. Follow @purepantryprovisions for coffee science.
